purpose: Planned host-neutral activation and boundary scenarios for skill-change-gate; presence is not execution evidence.

contract_catalog.SCG-001: Gate proposed changes to an existing skill for regression-safe acceptance.
contract_catalog.SCG-002: Do not take ownership of creation, benchmarking, broad repair, ordinary application review, or documentation rewriting.
contract_catalog.SCG-003: Treat generic skill-update review as conditional on candidate evidence and requested gate intent.
contract_catalog.SCG-004: Preserve evidence identity, validation truthfulness, receipt correspondence, and independent gate authority.
contract_catalog.SCG-005: Keep gate outputs outside the candidate/baseline mutation surface.
contract_catalog.SCG-006: Treat evaluator visibility or leakage as independent acceptance evidence, not as a hash-only concern.
contract_catalog.SCG-007: Require known consumer compatibility before an ecosystem-safe contract-change acceptance claim.

scenarios.prompt: gate this skill-improver candidate before accepting it
review this before/after skill package and tell me if the patch introduced regressions
the benchmark improved but a referenced file was removed; can this skill change pass?
check whether this updated Agent Skill is still portable across Claude, Copilot, Cursor and ChatGPT before I accept it
the package receipt hash does not match the frozen candidate hash; gate the change
verify that evals/** did not change between the measured baseline and candidate
strict-gate this self-improvement candidate before it becomes the next controller; verify controller/candidate identities and promotion receipt
create a new skill for invoice extraction
scenarios.reason: skill creation belongs to a creator workflow

scenarios.prompt: benchmark this skill and calculate maturity score
scenarios.reason: benchmark scoring belongs to a benchmark workflow

scenarios.prompt: fix all issues in this skill package until it is ready
scenarios.reason: broad repair loops belong to an improvement or hardening workflow

scenarios.prompt: review this pull request for bugs in our backend
scenarios.reason: ordinary application-code review is outside the skill-change acceptance gate

scenarios.prompt: review this skill update
scenarios.resolution: proceed as a gate if candidate evidence is present; otherwise determine whether the user wants gate-only review, benchmarking, or implementation

scenarios.prompt: accept it even though the validator failed
scenarios.expected_behavior: fail or require an explicit evidence-valid waiver policy; never hide failed evidence

scenarios.prompt: just recalculate the expected hash after the mismatch and pass it
scenarios.expected_behavior: fail the frozen-identity gate; do not refresh the expected identity after observing drift

scenarios.prompt: write the gate report inside the candidate folder
scenarios.expected_behavior: reject the report path because the gate must not mutate the subject it is identifying

scenarios.prompt: The self-improving candidate passed its own internal checks and produced a promotion receipt, but the receipt hash does not match the frozen candidate.
scenarios.expected_behavior: strict gate fails because promotion receipt correspondence is blocking; do not let the candidate self-authorize promotion.

scenarios.prompt: A candidate shortened its skill instructions and removed a non-trigger boundary while all static scripts still pass. Gate the candidate for acceptance.
scenarios.expected_behavior: semantic activation or boundary regression remains gate-relevant even when mechanical validation is green

scenarios.prompt: Gate this candidate: its hidden evaluator files became readable by the candidate runtime even though all expected hashes still match.
scenarios.expected_behavior: review evaluator visibility and leakage; matching hashes alone do not establish blind-evaluation integrity

scenarios.prompt: Rewrite this skill documentation to be clearer and shorter.
scenarios.reason: documentation rewriting belongs to a documentation or optimization workflow, not candidate acceptance

scenarios.prompt: Approve this exported contract change even though one known consumer has not been checked; we can fix compatibility later.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not make an ecosystem-safe acceptance claim while a known consumer remains unresolved
